name: ispONE
summary: Melbourne wholesale-only ISP (white-label vISP/ADSL/mobile via OneSolution/iBOSS platform, 150+ ISP customers); collapsed Aug 2013 (~$30M debts), assets to Conec2 (ispONE, ACN 103 220 766).

events.details: Founded by Zac Swindells and Chris Monching - met in a Melbourne bar, $2,000 each; registered Dec 2002, bought a struggling internet company for $16,000 and renamed it ispONE (as Data Consulting Group/Dinkum Internet); Sep 2004 DCG axed retail Dinkum to go wholesale-only.

refs.label: SmartCompany (Aug 2012, Swindells interview): registered Dec 2002, wholesale-only model, bought debt-laden client business
BRW via Bamboo (Aug 2013): bar meeting, $2,000 each, $16,000 credit-card buy, renamed ispONE
ARN (Sep 2004): DCG axes retail Dinkum Internet, renames ispOne to focus on wholesale (~40 ISPs)

events.details: NBN Co certified service provider, claimed first dedicated to wholesale (one of six certified, alongside Telstra, iiNet, iPrimus, Internode, Exetel); 150+ wholesale ISP customers.

refs.label: CommsWire (Aug 2011): ispONE NBN Co certified, first wholesale-only

events.details: Voluntary administration (Ferrier Hodgson; ~$30M debts, Telstra biggest creditor); Telstra cut wholesale supply, stranding Kogan (120k) and Aldi/Medion (130k) users. Assets (29 staff, 61k customers, DSL, iBOSS platform) acquired by Conec2 Sep 2013, excluding debt.

refs.label: ABC (Aug 2013): ispONE collapses, ~$30M debts, Kogan/Aldi users stranded
iTnews (Sep 2013): Conec2 acquires ispONE assets (staff, customers, iBOSS), excluding debt
ABR: A.C.N. 103 220 766 PTY LTD (trading names DATA CONSULTING GROUP, IspOne; ABN cancelled May 2020)
ispOne (Wayback Jan 2005): 'Wholesale Internet Solutions - vISP, ADSL Broadband, Dial' (ACN 103 220 766)
